revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - The reading in lin23 of Σώτου̣ instead of Σώται̣ is indeed preferable. In lin30 the suggested reading is indeed better - the omega form in this hand 2 is distinctly rounded which makes me think that the small ink trace after theta is much more likely to be an omicron. In lin32 the hand has changed again (hand 3) and it is easier to read καθὸς (l καθὼς) than καθότ̣ι̣ (where the space available leads to positing a very cramped version of the letters τι). Other points are fine.
Vote - AcceptText - Fine; I'm fine with the corrections and the new reading Sotou, but I cannot see kathoti in l 30 and 32. (R. Ast cannot see it either.)
